newsitem.title: USA: SOUTHDOWN TO CONVERT PFD SHARES TO COMMON.
newsitem.headline: SOUTHDOWN TO CONVERT PFD SHARES TO COMMON.

text.p: Southdown Inc said Monday it had elected to convert its $2.875 cumulative convertible Series D preferred stock into common shares.
It said the conversion rate is 1.511 shares of common for each share of Series D preferred.
The conversion will occur September 2, it said.
It said shareholders may convert the stock at any time prior to September 2.

It said articles of incorporation allow the conversion if, for at least 20 trading days within any period of 30 consecutive trading days, the closing price of the common stock on the New York Stock Exchange exceeds $43.02.
On Friday Southdown closed down 2-1/4 at 50.
